method: Hash each official decompressed Linux x64 ELF and Darwin arm64 Mach-O. Locate the interned concatenated JSON-RPC method tables and serde element-count strings. Decode Darwin compact-unwind function ranges and ADRP+ADD literal xrefs, and Linux .eh_frame_hdr ranges with RIP-relative LEA xrefs, without executing the file.

swallowtail_process_lifecycle.join_drain_release: Swallowtail begin_close is process.close_stdin plus process.request_stop. The vendor session/close JSON-RPC method stays unmapped.

compatibility_predicate: A hop stays on the existing behavior revision when both platforms keep the selected stdio 7-tuple, client 8-tuple, permission 4-tuple, initialize and prompt serde element counts, and the frozen 1.0.46 selected-literal presence digest. Extra interned packs may only add methods already present and unmapped at 1.0.46. Instruction-level function body hashes are recorded and may move under LTO; they are not the compatibility predicate.
